content.comment_body: I have developed a basic analog ramp using a PI controller and [product_no]. The ramp timing can be adjusted by setting the TI value, and using a small KC factor (up to 0.5) allows for faster ramping when there are larger input differences. Give it a try.

analysis.insight_summary: A user describes a straightforward way to build an analog ramp with a PI controller, sharing practical tips for modifying ramp timing and speed. There are no reported issues or requests for assistance, indicating the solution works as described.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects others to replicate the simple analog ramp setup as described and achieve effective performance using the configuration guidance.
